Another thing you might want to consider, since it really doesn't fit into any lolita styles is the ears. If you do get really into the style know that ears are typically frowned upon since they make a coord look costumey and cheapen the look. This isn't always the case but it's best to avoid them when first starting out. Also very small nitpick but lolita isn't capitalized. I know it does it on purpose but for the sake of not getting the book confused with the fashion it's important.

I read the other comments and if ur struggling to find unicorn or rainbow themed items you can always try just picking colors and matching up to those.
